caption: The chain starts at 0 dBm and subtracts 1.0 dB of connectors, 13.2 dB of 60 km fiber, 0.5 dB of splices and a 6 dB margin. The remaining 7.3 dB is spare before the receiver sensitivity of −28 dBm is reached.

spec.title: Walking the budget from transmitter to receiver
spec.aria: Left to right budget chain: 0 dBm launched, 1.0 dB of connectors, 13.2 dB of fiber, 0.5 dB of splices and a 6 dB margin, arriving at a receiver of −28 dBm sensitivity.
